Context is 1M tokens with 384K maximum output.

record.interface_detail: OpenAI-compatible POST /files, and an Anthropic-compatible /anthropic/v1/files; also list/retrieve/delete
record.tooling: openai-python with base_url https://api.deepseek.com; curl multipart; ai-sdk deepseek provider ships a file store
record.chaining: 25 GiB is per user, not per project. No obvious multiplicative axis except more accounts. Image-only format restriction (JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP, sniffed from content) makes it a picture store rather than a blob store.
record.limits_note: Per-object-cap 64 MiB. Upload must complete within 10 minutes. Count cap 10,000 files. `purpose` must be `user_data`. Omit `expires_after` for permanence. '少写一个参数，文件就永久留在他服务器上' (omit one parameter and the file stays on their server forever).
record.reliability_note: NO DOWNLOAD. The endpoint set is upload/list/retrieve-metadata/delete. There is no content-download route, and the docs describe retrieval as metadata only ('Retrieving file information returns metadata; it is not a request for the model to read the image'). 25 GiB of write-only image storage. Also: DeepSeek's platform forces phone binding on first login for some account classes (`platform.deepseek.com/mobile_verification` — 'please bind your phone number upon first login'), while international email+password signup is reported to work. Uncertain, hence medium.
